title: PT3 — Climate Change in My Community: Multimodal Presentation
summary: Create a multimodal presentation (forum, infographic, podcast, vlog, or similar) that effectively communicates the effects of climate change on the local ecosystem in your community.
instructions:
Your task is to create a multimodal presentation about the effects of climate change on the local ecosystem in your community. You will:

  1. Choose ONE format for your presentation:
    • Community forum — plan and document a short talk or Q&A with neighbors
    • Infographic — visual poster explaining the impacts
    • Podcast — 5–8 minute audio episode with narration/interviews
    • Vlog — 5–8 minute video documenting your community
    • Comic strip or photo essay — visual storytelling format
    • Website or digital booklet — interactive or PDF-based
  2. Investigate the LOCAL ecosystem — focus on your barangay, municipality, or province. Include specific details:
    • What ecosystem exists locally? (coastal, forest, agricultural, urban, river, lake, etc.)
    • What climate impacts are already being observed? (typhoons, floods, droughts, coral bleaching, saltwater intrusion, etc.)
    • Who is affected? (farmers, fisherfolk, students, small businesses, etc.)
  3. Include scientific content:
    • Explanation of the greenhouse effect and climate change
    • Biological responses to climate change (range shifts, extinction, adaptation)
    • At least 2 specific impacts on your local ecosystem with evidence
  4. Propose solutions — both adaptation (adjusting to impacts) and mitigation (reducing causes).
  5. Deliver or share your presentation — present to family, classmates, or community members, OR publish it online.
  6. Reflect on how creating this presentation changed your understanding of climate change in your own community.

Format: Submit as PDF, video, audio, or share a link. Include a copy of your script/plan if applicable.
requirements: Multimodal presentation in a chosen format (video, audio, infographic, etc.)
At least 2 local climate impacts with evidence or examples
Scientific explanation of greenhouse effect and climate change
Biological responses to climate change included
Both adaptation AND mitigation strategies proposed
Presentation shared or delivered to an audience
